title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(田中孝治研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Tanaka Koji)
keywords: Cognitive psychology 2.Cognitive science 3.Education engineering 4.Learning science 5.Knowledge science
educationalGoal: The aim is to be able to design and propose things and Kotozukuri that are conscious of the cognitive functions by fusing psychology and engineering. The basic policy is to make use of the knowledge of the mind works learned so far and the skills of scientific measurement and evaluation to tackle each theme. Students should always be aware of how human cognitive functions are organically linked to knowledge and behavior related to social life, and tackle your own research agenda.
advice: Seminars are held regularly throughout the year, and students will report on and discuss the status of each person's activities and research situation. At the end of the previous semester, a department presentation will be held to summarize the activities of the semester. At the end of the academic year, the results of the research will be compiled and presented. In order to demonstrate superior capabilities in a knowledge-based society, setting appropriate goals for truly unanswered problems and taking action based on beliefs appropriate to those goals and using available evidence (rational thinking) and self-direction to practice them autonomously are important. For maturity of rational thinking skills, we must generalize and learn from experiences of independent activities that deal with problems that are not truly answered. Research activities seem like questions that have no answer. Seminars are conducted as follows: through various proactive, research and laboratory activities, students learn from experience and set the goal of nurturing their ability to continue to grow after graduation. Also, human research hits more walls than you can imagine. For this reason, research activities require resilience (a tough mind). With the goal of fostering resilience, seminars are conducted so that not only successful experiences but also failed experiences can be accumulated.
requiredKnowledge: It is important to be interested in learning support that is based on human cognitive and psychological characteristics and to have some motivation to elucidate these characteristics. Completing the “Educational and School Psychology” course is recommended, but it is not essential.

activityGoals.body: Ability to psychologically explain how the human mind works.
Ability to use a method to measure and evaluate according to the theme.
Ability to explain how to make things and Kotozukuri that are used in the mind.
Ability to practice project activities autonomously using your knowledge and skills.
Ability to practice learning activities that maintain your growth.
Ability to obtain personal principles for future career paths.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students will tackle research on their theme using the knowledge and skills they have acquired through their studies. Students will give presentations at the end of each semester and submit final report. Furthermore, they have to further their research themes and obtain firm personal principles for their future career path.
achievementLevels.standard: Ability to use the knowledge and skills learned to carry out research on their theme. Students will give a presentation at the end of the semester, submit a final report, and plan their future career. Ability to obtain personal principles.
